title: Crypto and AI super PACs spent $250M in 2026 midterms, but lost 9/12 competitive races called so far, spending $74.7M on losing candidates and $28.3M on winners (Molly White/Citation Needed)
commentary: $250M buys a lot of influence — apparently just not votes. Crypto and AI lobbying's 2-to-1 loss rate suggests that writing big checks to shape your regulators works better in theory than in a midterm where 76% of voters oppose data centers in their backyard.
